scientific_integrity: The infinite claim is proved symbolically from the source paper's exact prime-power valuation formula. The included computation is only a regression check and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result verifies the source paper's structural condition (2) only for p=3 and p=5; it does not address p>=7. A later paper proves the global p-adic valuation bound unconditionally, so the novelty here is the stronger local structural condition. The later paper's full text was not accessible in the inspected lawful open sources, leaving a stated originality risk.
title: Condition (2) in the sum-of-divisors valuation conjecture holds for \(p=3\) and \(p=5\)
